items.title: Gemini 4 Neon now available on AI Gateway
items.summary: is now available on AI Gateway.Gemini 4 Neon from GoogleGemini 4 Neon is a major upgrade over the earlier, lighter Gemini 4 model, delivering output quality close to Google’s larger Gemini 4 models with faster responses. It’s built for coding, agent workflows, and multi-step tasks.The model accepts text, images, video, and documents, with a 1M-token context window. It supports tool calling, structured outputs, grounding with Google Search and Google Maps, and four reasoning levels: low, medium, high, and xhigh.Use  as the model ID:google/gemini-4-neonTo use Gemini 4 Neon in Codex, Cursor, or another supported agent, see the .coding agents guideTry Gemini 4 Neon in the , or explore .model playgroundall language modelsRead more
